packs.title: Universal Base Characters [Standard]
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.usedFor: Zeus (Superhero_Male_FullBody, Hair_Beard, Hair_SimpleParted) and the mortal (Superhero_Female_FullBody, Hair_SimpleParted); skinned to the UAL clips
packs.note: Material textures are not used: every material is replaced by a palette ramp. The Standard tier ships two base characters.
